Karissa Marino Morehouse brings more than 20 years of higher education leadership experience and a deep commitment to student success to her role as Interim President of Yuba College. Having served as Yuba College’s Vice President of Student Services for the past two years, Morehouse understands the college’s mission, the needs of its students, and the important role it plays in the Yuba-Sutter community.

Throughout her career in higher education, Morehouse has held leadership positions across the California community college system, including Vice President of Instruction and Assistant Superintendent. Her experience spans academic programs, student services, and initiatives designed to create more accessible educational opportunities. In previous roles, she developed accelerated educational pathways for student veterans, helping them navigate college and achieve their academic goals. She continues to bring that commitment to Yuba College through efforts to strengthen services and expand opportunities for veterans.
Home About Yuba College Office of the President

Karissa Marino Morehouse brings more than 20 years of higher education leadership experience and a deep commitment to student success to her role as Interim President of Yuba College. Having served as Yuba College’s Vice President of Student Services for the past two years, Morehouse understands the college’s mission, the needs of its students, and the important role it plays in the Yuba-Sutter community.

Throughout her career in higher education, Morehouse has held leadership positions across the California community college system, including Vice President of Instruction and Assistant Superintendent. Her experience spans academic programs, student services, and initiatives designed to create more accessible educational opportunities. In previous roles, she developed accelerated educational pathways for student veterans, helping them navigate college and achieve their academic goals. She continues to bring that commitment to Yuba College through efforts to strengthen services and expand opportunities for veterans.

Morehouse’s connection to community colleges is also personal. As a former community college student, she discovered her academic interests and found the support and encouragement that helped her succeed. The guidance she received from faculty and classified professionals gave her the confidence to continue her education, earn her bachelor’s degree from Cal Poly, San Luis Obispo, and complete her master’s degree at Chico State.

A resident of rural Northern California for more than 20 years, Morehouse believes in the connection between a college and the communities it serves. Her community involvement includes serving on the Harmony Health Board of Directors and working with local agencies, including the Sutter and Yuba County public health departments, to support access to quality health services throughout the region.

As Interim President, Morehouse is focused on advancing Yuba College’s Educational Master Plan, with an emphasis on helping students persist in their studies, remain enrolled, and complete their degrees and certificates.

Through her professional experience, personal connection to community colleges, and longstanding ties to rural Northern California, Morehouse is committed to supporting Yuba College students and strengthening the college’s role as an educational resource and community partner throughout the Yuba-Sutter region.

excerpts.line: Chancellor Pan’s Monthly Virtual “Open Door” Sessions
window: When asked what advice has stayed with her throughout her career, Ana shared: “Lead with kindness, but don’t be afraid to have difficult conversations. People may not always remember what you said, but they’ll always remember how you made them feel.”
With her passion for people, problem-solving, and finding innovative ways to support employees, Ana looks forward to continuing to make a positive impact across the District.
Chancellor Pan’s Monthly Virtual “Open Door” Sessions

To better accommodate busy schedules and connect with more members of our campus community, Chancellor Pan will continue to offer monthly virtual Chancellor’s Open Door sessions for the 2026-2027 academic year.
These informal gatherings provide faculty, staff, and students across the Yuba Community College District an opportunity to engage directly with the Chancellor in a relaxed, conversational setting.
Have a question, idea, or just want to say hello? Stop by virtually and join the conversation.
